# Cameras for the disc-wide cull sweep (port/render/test/gsb_cull_test.c --sweep, the
# gsb_cull_sweep ctest; docs/port/TESTING_PROGRAMS.md).  One line per camera: the stage's folder name
# (object/sdf/<stage>/), then the frame camera the sweep is about, as numbers:
#   STAGE camera NAME V0 .. V15 zoom Z
# the view (world to view, column-major, the translation in V12 .. V14) and the zoom of a captured
# frame's camera (its dump header's RdCamera view and zoom, read once and written here with nine
# significant digits, which give back each float exactly); NAME says which frame it was.  The stage
# is the prefix of that frame's mesh names.  "STAGE builtin:i76" is the camera of the reporter's dump
# i76 (gsb_cull_test.c kI76View).  A local list may also name a dump ("STAGE DUMP": its header is
# read); this list names none, so the test reads nothing from outside the repository.  Every line is
# a 768-step sweep (every 4th pair by default) at 16:9 and 48:9 for its stage, so a stage with many
# lines (st17a has 14) costs that many sweeps: drop lines of near-identical cameras if its shard runs
# long (phone-v3347, phone-v4651 and phone-v4657 are the same camera to 0.0003 units).  A stage with
# no line is not swept.
#
# The frames of the v0.7.x corpus (the October 2026 VU captures) show the queenmodel only (the
# ending): no stage, left out.  The issue 179 (st13b, v2915) and issue 182 (st26a, v3225) captures
# are no longer on the maintainer's machine: their cameras are not here, so st26a has no line.
#
# st18a, issue 29's stage: the camera of the reporter's dump i76
st18a builtin:i76
#
